parsed.name: quality_momentum_biotech_semis
parsed.strategy: Bet on liquid quality-momentum: names with strong 6-12 month momentum, positive net analyst raises, and improving gross margin, concentrated in large-cap pharma/biotech with dated Q4 PDUFA catalysts plus semicap and AI power-grid hardware. I avoid names far above their 200-day with falling margins (ALB, VRT, FLUT, CEG, LEU, SMR, OKLO all show negative net_raises). I would be wrong if a hyperscaler capex pause hits semis and power together, or if a cluster of Q4 PDUFAs draws CRLs, or if the momentum factor reverses sharply.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, via quality-momentum names with positive revision flow and dated catalysts.

strategy.brief: Quality momentum: liquid names with strong 6-12 month momentum (mom_252_21) AND improving gross margin; avoid names far above their 200-day with falling margins.
